# Lyrascent Learning

> Lyrascent Learning is a free personal AI tutor for K-12 children: math, reading, science, languages and typing in one place, with hints that teach instead of just giving the answer. Parents sign in with their own Google account at https://app.lyrascent.com. The AI tutor needs the family's own free Google Gemini key; without a key everything else still works.

## What it does
- A quick check-in finds where each child is, then a quest map unlocks one skill at a time
- An AI tutor the child can chat with; the tutor can make mistakes, so parents stay in charge
- Parents set screen-time limits; no ads; free for families, no payment and no card
- Language practice in Spanish, Chinese, Vietnamese, French and Japanese

## Not offered
It is not a licensed school and gives no grades, transcripts or accreditation.

## Prices
Free for families. No payment is asked for.

## Contact
